page_summary:
The Collected Stories of Philip K. Dick, Volumes 1-5 is the canonical works record for PKD's short-story collection. It preserves a single archive manifestation and gives the work a stable bibliographic home. The preserved item here is The Collected Stories of Philip K. Dick, Volumes 1-5 (1987). The archive copy runs 2275 pages.

reading.significance: As the most complete single gathering of Dick's short fiction ever published, this omnibus is essential for any serious study of his development as a writer, documenting the extraordinary range of speculative premises he produced across three decades of prolific magazine writing.
reading.closing_note: This entry documents the omnibus as a publishing object; readers seeking analysis of individual stories should consult each story's own dossier elsewhere in this corpus.
